ANT: One of the most highly rated young talents of his generation, Antonelli rose through the Mercedes junior programme, skipping Formula 3 entirely on his way to the top level. The Italian made his Formula 1 debut with Mercedes.
RUS: The 2018 FIA Formula 2 champion, Russell earned his promotion to Mercedes after three seasons at Williams. A proven race winner, he has become a consistent front-runner for the works Mercedes team.
HAM: A seven-time Formula 1 World Champion and the holder of the record for most Grand Prix victories, Hamilton is one of the most successful drivers in the sport's history. After a record-breaking spell at Mercedes, he joined Ferrari to continue his career at the sport's most storied team.
NOR: Norris has spent his entire Formula 1 career with McLaren, making his debut in 2019. A multiple race winner, he has grown into the team's lead driver and a regular championship contender.
LEC: The 2017 FIA Formula 2 champion, Leclerc has raced for Ferrari since 2019. A multiple race winner and pole-sitter, he is the first Monegasque driver to win a Grand Prix.
VER: A four-time Formula 1 World Champion, Verstappen is the youngest driver ever to start a Grand Prix and to win one. He has led Red Bull Racing through a dominant era of success.
PIA: Piastri won the FIA Formula 3 and Formula 2 championships in consecutive seasons before joining McLaren in 2023. The Australian has since established himself as a race winner and front-runner.
HAD: A product of the Red Bull junior programme, Hadjar finished runner-up in the 2024 Formula 2 championship. After making his debut with Racing Bulls, the Frenchman earned promotion to Red Bull Racing.
LAW: A Red Bull junior, Lawson impressed as a mid-season substitute before earning a full-time race seat. The New Zealander now races for Racing Bulls.
GAS: Gasly is best known for winning the 2020 Italian Grand Prix with AlphaTauri, one of the sport's most memorable underdog victories. The Frenchman now races for Alpine.
LIN: One of the youngest drivers on the grid, Lindblad is a highly rated Red Bull junior who made his Formula 1 debut with Racing Bulls. The British racer is regarded as one of the sport's brightest prospects.
COL: Colapinto made his Formula 1 debut mid-season with Williams in 2024 and quickly impressed with his pace. The Argentine now races for Alpine.
BEA: A Ferrari junior, Bearman made a stunning Formula 1 debut in 2024 when he deputised for an injured driver. The British racer now competes full-time for Haas.
BOR: The 2024 FIA Formula 2 champion, Bortoleto earned his Formula 1 seat with the Audi project. The Brazilian is regarded as one of the most promising drivers of his generation.
HUL: A veteran of well over a decade in Formula 1, Hulkenberg is known for his consistency and experience. The German now drives for the Audi project.
SAI: A multiple race winner, Sainz has raced for some of the sport's biggest teams, including Ferrari. The Spaniard now drives for Williams.
ALB: Albon rebuilt his Formula 1 career at Williams after earlier spells at Red Bull and Toro Rosso. The Thai driver has become the team's consistent lead racer.
OCO: Ocon won the 2021 Hungarian Grand Prix, the highlight of a career spanning several teams. The Frenchman now races for Haas.
ALO: A two-time Formula 1 World Champion, Alonso is the most experienced driver on the grid, with a career spanning more than two decades. The Spaniard continues to race with Aston Martin.
TSU: A Red Bull junior, Tsunoda made his Formula 1 debut in 2021 and has grown into a dependable midfield racer. The Japanese driver races for Racing Bulls.
STR: Stroll has raced in Formula 1 since 2017 and has claimed multiple podium finishes. The Canadian drives for Aston Martin.
BOT: A ten-time Grand Prix winner, Bottas spent a successful spell at Mercedes as part of five championship-winning campaigns. The Finn now races for Cadillac.
PER: A six-time Grand Prix winner, Perez is one of the most successful Mexican drivers in Formula 1 history. He now races for Cadillac after a long spell at Red Bull Racing.
